newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1997/98 corn output revised down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1997/98 corn output revised down slightly.

text.p: Thailand on Monday revised the projection for its 1997/98 (July-June) corn production down slightly to 4.52 million tonnes from 4.53 million seen earlier.

A senior agriculture ministry official said the forecast was revised down slightly as latest surveys indicated that some farmers in major growing areas had switched to other crops which fetched more money.
"In some provinces, we found farmers switching to ginger, for example, which commands very bullish prices this year," he said.
"But we do not think that the overall output will drop much as more farmers are using new high-yielding hybrids which are also more resistant to disease," he said.
The yield was revised up to 3.21 tonnes per hectare from 3.18 tonnes earlier. The planting area was put at 1.40 million hectares, down from 1.43 million hectares seen earlier.
